description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves IMPETUOSITY (Saga of the Beastslayer, 1 CP) — WP-S3. Fixture sw11e_s3_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Wolves, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The Ork Gretchin shoot the Wulfen (the shooting panel's SHOOT); enemy_has_shot opens for the Space Wolves player with the Wulfen in ctx.targeted_unit_ids; a real click on 'Use on Wulfen' spends 1 CP and opens the reactive-move panel (D6 rolled, surge toward the closest enemy unit); real clicks on Auto-move and Confirm surge the Wulfen closer to the Gretchin.
